definitions.explanation: A professional who adjusts the pitch and tone of pianos and other keyboard instruments to ensure correct intonation.

examples.japanese: {調律師|ちょうりつし}にピアノを{見|み}てもらった。
examples.english: I had a piano tuner look at the piano.

examples.japanese: {調律師|ちょうりつし}は{年|ねん}に{一度|いちど}は{呼|よ}んだほうがいい。
examples.english: You should call a piano tuner at least once a year.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{長年|ながねん}の{経験|けいけん}を{持|も}つベテランの{調律師|ちょうりつし}で、コンサートホールからも{依頼|いらい}がある。
examples.english: He is a veteran piano tuner with many years of experience, and even receives requests from concert halls.

notes:
USAGE:
{調律師|ちょうりつし} specifically refers to someone who tunes pianos professionally. The base word {調律|ちょうりつ} means "tuning" (of a musical instrument), and {師|し} is the suffix for a skilled professional.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {調律師|ちょうりつし}を{呼|よ}ぶ (to call a tuner)
- {調律師|ちょうりつし}に{依頼|いらい}する (to request a tuner)
- ピアノ{調律師|ちょうりつし} (piano tuner)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {調律|ちょうりつ}: tuning (the act itself)
- {調|ちょう}べる: to check, to examine (general)
